claim: Two #579 workers left contradictory diagnoses for the residual emulator reds. Worker 1: FRAUD_PROOF_CATALOGUE_CATEGORY_ORDER carries 11 categories against 18 validator directories, and that single registration gap explains 32 emulator rows + 2 scaffold rows + 5 validation rows. Worker 2: the deployed catalogue genuinely has 11 categories, the residual reds are #575 offchain-builder staleness, and the two new families belong in UNCATEGORISED_VALIDATOR_DIRECTORIES.
verdict: WORKER_2_CORRECT — worker 1's attribution was STALE. No registration gap. No code changed.
resolvedBy: measurement, per the standing rule that the deployed-catalogue-order measurement rules over any source-level count

theMeasurement.question: How many categories does the DEPLOYED catalogue actually have?
theMeasurement.authorityChain: onchain/aiken/plutus.json -> buildFaultProofContracts (demo/midgard-sdk/src/fraud-proof/contracts.ts:2400) -> contracts.fraudProofs -> fraudProofsToIndexedValidators (demo/midgard-node/src/transactions/initialization.ts:82) -> createFraudProofCatalogueMpf (:115) -> MPF insert(categoryId -> spendingScriptHash) -> the datum posted at Init.
theMeasurement.onchainPinsNothing: onchain/aiken/lib/midgard/fraud-proof-catalogue.ak declares only `pub type Datum = MerkleRoot<Int, ByteArray>`. There is no category enumeration, no count and no hardcoded category id anywhere under onchain/aiken/validators/fraud-proofs/. The deployed count is therefore whatever the builder inserts, which is why it had to be measured by running the builder rather than read off a constant.
theMeasurement.method: The regenerated blueprint was run through the real SDK builder and the catalogue keys inserted exactly as initialization.ts does.
theMeasurement.conclusion: The bijection is perfect and empty in both directions. 18 validator DIRECTORIES is not 18 CATEGORIES: a directory is verifier logic, a category needs a deployable SpendingValidator chain, and the blueprint-derived builder produces 11.

whyTheGapIsNotEvenExpressible: canonicalDecodability and committedFieldShape appear in no chain builder — not in FraudProofs (demo/midgard-sdk/src/common.ts:214, exactly 11 keys, and the order constant is `satisfies readonly (keyof FraudProofs)[]`), not in MidgardValidators, not in FaultProofContracts, not in DEPLOYMENT_MANIFEST_V1_CONTRACT_NAMES. Grep across demo/*/src finds them only inside demo/midgard-sdk/src/fraud-proof/canonical-decodability-v1.ts, a pure verifier module with no chain builder. There is no SpendingValidator to register, so worker 1's fix could not be applied without first writing new chain builders. Worker 2's placement of both directories in UNCATEGORISED_VALIDATOR_DIRECTORIES is correct and measured.

causalTestOfWorker1sHypothesis.method: Counterfactual through the ABI gate's --source-sdkCatalogue override with a synthetic 13-entry catalogue (11 + canonicalDecodability + committedFieldShape). Nothing in the repository was modified.
violationsAdded: ABI-02 is not frozen: sdkCatalogue.FRAUD_PROOF_CATALOGUE_CATEGORY_ORDER disagrees with core's DEPLOYMENT_MANIFEST_V1_FRAUD_PROOF_CATALOGUE_CATEGORY_ORDER
ABI-02 is positional and its declarations disagree in order
ABI-02 publishes declarationOrder IDENTICAL but the sources measure DIVERGENT
alsoWouldRedden: midgard-core: 'authenticates the exact eleven-entry fraud-proof catalogue root and proofs'
causalTestOfWorker1sHypothesis.conclusion: Worker 1's proposed fix adds three violations and removes none. No residual red traces to the category order.

worker1PopulationsReattributed.actualCause: Q02 permissive-dispatch scanner fires 4 findings on artifacts added after its clean baseline (native-binding-fixture-v1.ak:500 ak_catch_all_arm, plus ts_dynamic_registry_dispatch in canonical-decodability-v1.ts:363, committed-field-shape-v1.ts:307, field-preimage-carriage-v1.ts:527); and the Q02 zero-input mirror fails on a missing `use midgard/ledger_state.{MidgardInput...}` import, which is the #575 rebind.

26 are on-chain script rejections at emulator submission ('the validator crashed / exited prematurely', one 'unexpected empty list') — the exact docs/fault-proofs/offchain-builder-staleness-575.md signature.
Pinned applied-script digests, blueprint redeemer field names moved by #579's own regeneration, and one pre-existing evidence gap.

worker2RebindLineReproduced.mechanism: da-hash-preimage/*.ak uses no field door. input-no-idx, no-reference-input, invalid-signature and reference-input-no-idx all do (opened_field_view / field_preimage_certificate_policy_id).
worker2RebindLineReproduced.correctionToTheStalenessDoc: reference-input-no-idx is NOT one of #575's named nine families, but it acquired the field door in #592/#594. The door-bound set is therefore slightly wider than the nine the doc lists, and the doc's list should not be read as the full affected set.

corroboratingIndependentMeasurements: demo/scripts/verify-canonical-v1-abi-freeze.mjs reports 'catalogue categories: 11, validator directories: 18' and ABI-02 agreement EXACT at cardinality 11 across core and sdk.

The ABI gate has a dedicated drift finding for exactly this hypothesis, f20-registered-categories-behind-the-frozen-catalogue (verify-canonical-v1-abi-freeze.mjs:813). It did NOT fire. The only F20 finding that fired was f20-validator-directories-behind-the-index, which is an unstaged-evidence artifact, not a registration gap.
demo/midgard-node/tests/fraud-proof-catalogue.test.ts passes; its assertion IS the registration check (indexedFraudProofs names must equal Object.keys(fraudProofs)).
